name: Affle 3I Ltd
title: Affle 3I Ltd - 542752 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 20.3% y-o-y to INR 7.24bn with EBITDA margin 22.3%, but management is deliberately investing in data and inventory costs, pushing gross margin down, and is raising INR 11bn via warrants for M&A.

triggers.label: INR 11bn warrant issue for acquisitions
triggers.quote: Affle Holdings, will invest to acquire ~7.4 million warrants at INR 1,487, totaling approximately INR 11 billion, with 25% upfront payment.

triggers.label: Inventory and data cost 63.3% of revenue, up ~90bps q-o-q
triggers.quote: our inventory and data costs stood at 63.3% of the revenues for the quarter, an increase of approximately 90 basis points sequentially.

triggers.label: Gross margin investment to last about a year
triggers.quote: I believe in about a year, we should be able to achieve the level of verticalization and the level of intel that we need

guidance.quote: delivering about 20%+ growth over the next 5 years is our goal.
delivering close to about 23% to 25% EBITDA over a period of time.

red_flags.label: Gross margin compression from data/inventory spend
red_flags.quote: our inventory and data costs stood at 63.3% of the revenues for the quarter, an increase of approximately 90 basis points sequentially.

red_flags.label: Acquisition timing and target undisclosed
red_flags.quote: There's no pressure to act like today or tomorrow, but we are making sure that we execute at the right terms at the right price

evasions.quote: I wouldn't want to give any color to the size of the transaction because there are a few small transactions as well.
We will not be able to disclose that kind of detail of the information.
But what is the source of funding of Affle Holdings? If any notification comes from Affle Holdings to us, we will definitely disclose it to the stock exchange.
